recorded.prompt:q-penalty:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-penalty:a: "A smaller penalty lets it drop a visit just because it is out of the way." 10 is far below the sum.
recorded.prompt:q-penalty:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-penalty:b: Same passage: a penalty below the arc sum lets drops pay off; at 0 every drop is free. "The solver drops a site whenever dropping it saves more than its penalty."
recorded.prompt:q-penalty:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-penalty:c: A share of 6,000 is below the arc sum, and "A smaller penalty lets it drop a visit just because it is out of the way."

recorded.prompt:q-dropped:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-dropped:c: "its own successor". Also, "a start index is never a visit".
